commit_scope: Restore the canonical api.coherencycoin.com Traefik route on the fkwu-owning API container before retired sibling routers are removed.

task_card.goal: Keep app.hati.earth connected to its deployed API after the fkwu authority retires sibling kernel-router containers.
done_when: The deploy reconciles api.coherencycoin.com directly onto api:8000 before sibling ingress is retired.
The running API container proves it owns the canonical Host route after sibling retirement.
An exact-head Hostinger rollout and live app.hati.earth Sheet recovery flow pass.
constraints: Keep the c-bootstrapped fkwu inside the API image as the sole production Form execution authority.
Do not restore Rust, Go, or TypeScript sibling kernels as production services.
Do not expose household tokens, balances, transaction rows, Sheet secrets, or private URLs.

evidence_refs: Hostinger Auto Deploy run 38049369680 built and started healthy API and web containers at merge commit 3674a17f72bf5c3b9b5b4309f5de99bf6553f11c.
The same run retired the kernel-router and kernel-router-bml-front-door sibling containers, after which every public API check returned Traefik HTTP 404 while the API container remained healthy.
The deploy script previously reconciled Hati web Host labels but assumed an external base API router already existed underneath the retired sibling ingress.
The public-host reconciler now owns both the canonical api.coherencycoin.com route to api:8000 and the Hati web host family before any early-aligned exit or sibling retirement.
The aligned rerun path now updates both api and web services so Traefik receives label-only repairs even when source and running SHA already match.

The aligned rerun also retires any stale higher-priority proof-sibling routers and verifies the running API Host route before it may return success; the exact-head review finding that exposed this interrupted-rollout gap is covered by an executable path-order assertion.
After sibling retirement, the deploy inspects the running API container and fails immediately unless its canonical Host rule, service binding, entrypoint, certificate resolver, and port are present.

The fixture executes the actual embedded reconciler with mapping-style API labels and list-style web labels, retains unrelated labels, creates each canonical route once, and proves a second run is byte-for-byte unchanged.
No household token, balance, transaction row, Sheet secret, or private URL is present in this evidence.
